name: AI Product Studio for WooCommerce
author: Clugins

sections.description:
AI Product Studio for WooCommerce helps store owners create ready-to-review WooCommerce product drafts from rough product notes, pricing, optional images, and optional existing product categories.

This plugin supports one-at-a-time product draft creation. It uses OpenAI as the AI provider, uses your own OpenAI API key, and creates WooCommerce products as drafts so store owners can review and edit them before publishing.

Features include:

  • OpenAI-powered product draft generation.
  • One-at-a-time product draft creation with your own OpenAI API key.
  • Manual OpenAI model name field with an optional recommended default.
  • Draft-only WooCommerce product creation.
  • Existing WooCommerce category selection.
  • Optional product images assigned to the draft when selected.
  • Safe API key storage in WordPress.
  • Connection check for the configured OpenAI API key.

Published by Clugins:
https://clugins.com/

External Services

AI Product Studio for WooCommerce connects to OpenAI when you check the OpenAI connection or generate product data.

Data sent to OpenAI may include product notes and selected product context, such as selected product kind, price, optional sale price, optional SKU, optional stock quantity, and selected WooCommerce category label.

The prompt flow does not send image binaries to OpenAI.

Your OpenAI API key is stored locally in your WordPress database and is used by your site to send requests directly to OpenAI.

OpenAI service information:

  • Service: OpenAI API
  • Website: https://openai.com/
  • Terms: https://openai.com/policies/terms-of-use/
  • Privacy Policy: https://openai.com/policies/privacy-policy/
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/ai-product-studio-for-woocommerce/ directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress Plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins screen in WordPress.
  3. Make sure WooCommerce is installed and active.
  4. Go to AI Product Studio > Settings.
  5. Add your OpenAI API key and run Check Connection.
  6. Open Create Product and generate a WooCommerce draft.
sections.faq:
Which AI provider does this plugin use?

This plugin uses OpenAI.

Do I need my own OpenAI API key?

Yes. You need your own OpenAI API key. OpenAI usage is billed directly by OpenAI.

Can I choose the OpenAI model?

Yes. You can enter an OpenAI model name in the plugin settings. If you leave the model field empty, the plugin uses its recommended default.

What does the plugin create?

The plugin creates one WooCommerce draft product at a time with AI-generated title, short description, long description, and missing information notes for review.

Are products published automatically?

No. Products are created as WooCommerce drafts so you can review and edit them before publishing.

Are image files sent to OpenAI?

No. The prompt flow does not send image binaries to OpenAI. Selected images are assigned to the WooCommerce draft after generation.
